name: Free Bee
summary:
Free Bee is a voice-first algebra game. Instead of filling in boxes, you talk through the math the way you would with a tutor, and a friendly bee does the carrying.

SAY IT, SEE IT
Tell Free Bee what to do to both sides. Your bee flies each tile to a two-pan balance in front of you, so you can see that every move keeps the equation level.

YOUR METHOD COUNTS
Most math apps grade one method. Free Bee checks the reasoning instead. Use elimination, substitution, "little into big", matching terms or opposites c
